name: Spectrum Remix
author: jstn (remix of Spectrum by Dragos Robu)
description: A remix of Spectrum: the live octave-band visualizer is tinted from your Omarchy theme's accent, and the hover card adds a Now Playing section with previous, play/pause and next controls.

barWidget.description: Theme-coloured mini spectrum in the bar; hover for a 60-band analyzer plus Now Playing with previous / play-pause / next. Click to pin, middle-click to pause the capture.

schema.label: Bar colours
schema.description: "theme" (default) shades every band from the theme accent; "palette" uses the original warm/mid/cool picks from the theme palette.

schema.label: Music sink (before EQ)
schema.description: Optional. PipeWire node name of your EQ's input sink. Set both sinks to get a Music / Speakers toggle; leave empty to follow the default output.

schema.label: Speaker sink (after EQ)
schema.description: Optional. PipeWire node name of the hardware sink the EQ feeds.
